description: This file defines the BatchContainerBatch class, which represents a batch of batch containers in Orleans streaming. It provides properties to access stream ID, sequence token, and contained batch containers, as well as methods to retrieve events and import request context.

classes.name: BatchContainerBatch
classes.description: A class representing a batch of batch containers in Orleans streaming, providing access to stream ID, sequence token, contained batch containers, and methods to retrieve events and import request context.

methods.name: BatchContainerBatch
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the batch with a list of batch containers, extracting stream ID and sequence token from the first container.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves all events of type T from the contained batch containers.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context from the first batch container.
